reason: The loose sand suggests the rover needs traction, so combining the metal stock and cargo mesh seems like a useful way to prepare a crossing surface.
expectation: I expect some kind of traction aid for the wheels, though I don't know exactly what it will make.

alternatives.reason: The gravel patch may provide useful material, but I would first try making something to help the rover cross the sand.

effect: The panels need gravel to provide a firm surface for the wheels, so gathering suitable material is the next step.
reaction: The raised edges holding gravel make the panels' purpose clear.
reason: Sieving the gravel patch is the only available combination and seems likely to prepare material for the panels.
expectation: I expect to collect or grade gravel that will fit in the traction panels, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The sieve produced coarse gravel, which can now be combined with the traction panels.
reaction: The result was expected and makes the next step clear.
reason: Filling the panels with gravel is the only available combination and should prepare them to support the rover on loose sand.
expectation: I expect gravel-filled traction panels ready to place on the crossing, though I don't know if another preparation will be needed.

effect: The gravel-filled frames completed the crossing preparation and clarified how the stones and frames work together to support the wheels.
reaction: The explanation was satisfying, though I expected the result.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the traction panels was most worthwhile: their mesh bottoms and raised edges explained how a simple structure can spread wheel weight and hold gravel in place.

leastWorthwhile.text: Sieving the gravel was straightforward and gave little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The raised edges holding gravel in the panels made the traction aid more specific than I had expected.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to preparing the crossing.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because I want to see what the second core reveals and how the specimens get home. This chapter prepared the crossing but ended before the collection.
